leverage.exposure: No leveraged position is open and none can open from the live bids. This is the material change of the run: with Eggestein withdrawn, the total committed across all three outstanding auctions is well inside available cash, so the balance stays positive on every branch. All three auctions also resolve before the transfer window shuts, so the squad size is known before the Sylla decision has to be made. Sylla's departure would still cost a body rather than merely a funding leg, which is the one residual risk worth watching over the next day.

binding_gap: One empty slot. It closes automatically if any of the three live auctions clears, and the earliest of them resolves in the small hours of the morning, well before the transfer window shuts. No further action is available to close it faster - the bids are already placed above every premium ever measured here. The safety net stands: if all three are somehow lost, buy any cheap outfield body immediately, and under no circumstances a second keeper. Three keepers are currently sitting on the board at or near the floor price and they exist to tempt exactly that mistake.

verdict.headline: No action tonight.
verdict.detail: No action tonight. Georg placed all three raises exactly as recommended, and every one of them now sits above the high clearing cluster that governs contested Kickbase board listings. The bids are correct; raising again would only overpay. The one structural change this run is that Eggestein has been withdrawn from the market by his owner, which removes the single leg that was driving the projected negative balance. That risk is now gone: even a clean sweep of all three live auctions leaves the balance comfortably positive, so the unwind-before-the-lock urgency that dominated the last several runs is void. Selling is once again purely about points and about Sylla's exit risk, not about clearing leverage before matchday.

sell.reason: Sell nothing tonight. At ten players a sale takes the squad to nine and deepens the penalty rather than funding anything, and with the leverage risk gone there is no longer any reason to force one. The moment a buy lands, Sylla goes first - he is the worst scorer in the squad and carries a live, dated exit risk. Bernardo follows: he is carrying a knock and his value is bleeding faster than anyone else's. Widmer and Lokonga are only in scope once the squad is comfortably above the minimum, and with Eggestein gone there is no replacement lined up for Lokonga, so his sale should now wait.

standing.name: Sylla
standing.why: Replaces SELL-syl (closed) - PROMOTED from "funding leg 1, only if a bid lands" to the FIRST sale to execute, with a hard deadline. NEW: fussballeuropa 31.08.2026 08:45Z - Club Brugge intends to bid before the deadline, Schalke has cut the ask to a EUR 4M minimum and is only deciding whether letting him go now makes sporting sense; CEO Tillmann: a sale "is currently included in our budget figures". Corroborated by schalketotal 24.08/26.08/27.08 (Schalke needs the transfer millions, price lowered). German window shuts 01.09 18:00Z; the Belgian window runs ~4 days longer, so an exit can complete after the German deadline - the risk does not end at 18:00Z. He is the worst scorer in the squad at ap 21, mv 9.096.588 with sdmvt -670.248 (~670k/day of decay), and he was always the designated sale. Sale allowance is ZERO until a buy lands (squad exactly 11) - see BUY B3z76og on Nguefack, which exists to unlock this. Dump to Kickbase at mv rather than list: a manager ask clears +3,06% to +4,35% (~280k-400k more) but takes days he does not have, and Keidel just proved the manager route works only when someone wants the player. Sell the moment the allowance exists.

standing.name: Bernardo
standing.why: Replaces Sydvapy (closed) and REVERSES its partial walk-back. Sydvapy said "the hooked-at-53 premise is NOT corroborated" and demoted this to a purely financial call. It IS corroborated, by Kickbase itself: get_player 1954 now returns st=2, stl=[2], stxt "Stricken - does not come through KOE (A) unscathed", status timestamp 2026-08-31T10:44:32Z. He picked up a knock in the MD1 game at Koeln - that is why he came off at 53 (Ligainsider confirms exactly 1 appearance / 53 minutes in 2026/27), and it was an injury hook, not a Hranac demotion. No club statement yet: Ligainsider's Bernardo profile still ends at 28.08.2026 "Bernardo meldet sich fuer Koeln zurueck" and he is NOT on the Verletzte-und-Gesperrte table, so treat this as doubtful, not ruled out. NOTE THE DATE TRAP that caught an earlier run: the "Bernardo faellt verletzungsbedingt aus" item (Ligainsider 408617 / the TSG tweet naming a Bayern away XI) is 08.02.2026, LAST SEASON - Hoffenheim's MD2 opponent is Dortmund on 2026-09-05T13:30Z, not Bayern. Effect on the plan: the case is no longer only financial. He is now a doubtful starter carrying ap 61 in a fielded XI that cannot be reshuffled at 11 players, and mv 6.547.852 with sdmvt -1.013.483 keeps bleeding ~1M/day. He OVERTAKES Sambi Lokonga (ap 44, fit, starter, mv falling only 190k/day) as the sale to make once Sylla and Suzuki are done: selling Bernardo and keeping Lokonga puts ap 44 into the XI in place of a flagged ap 61 and stops the faster bleed. Sell EARLY if sold at all.

buy.reason: Nothing new to buy. The three live bids are the buy list and they are correctly priced - deliberately above the high cluster, which is the lesson of four consecutive auctions lost by underbidding. Every one of them was re-verified against Ligainsider's injury and suspension table this run and none appears on it. The board's new arrivals are both rejections: a goalkeeper who cannot be fielded alongside the incumbent, and a midfielder with a negative points return at more than double the price of the body already bid for. Eggestein, the one genuine midfield upgrade in play, is off the market; if he is relisted at or near his value he is worth reopening, but only once the squad is legal and only at the low manager-ask premium, never the high one.

killed_this_run.name: Raab
killed_this_run.why: NEW Kickbase listing 31.08 22:18:37Z, the freshest thing on the board this run. Elversberg GK, mv 5.345.826 at exactly mv, st=0, ap 9, expires ~2026-09-01T17:34Z. This is the THIRD floor-or-mv keeper to appear in 24h alongside Florian Mueller (1910, A99hepd) and Wisbereit (13671, A0p4kqx), and it is rejected for the same structural reason plus a price one. STRUCTURAL: only 1 GK can be fielded, so a squad carrying 2 keepers has one fewer usable outfield body and fills fewer formations, not more - Baumann (ap 129) is the incumbent and is not being displaced. PRICE: 5,35M for ap 9 is dreadful points-per-euro even ignoring the structure; Nguefack does the body job at 1,11M with ap 17 and a bid already live. Also covers Nadir (15478), the other new listing this run: Mainz MID, Kickbase listing 31.08 21:12:32Z at exactly mv 2.424.073, st=0, ap MINUS 11, expires 2026-09-02T09:34Z - a negative scorer at more than double Nguefack's price. movers.reason: No flip this run. There are no manager asks sitting below market value anywhere on the board, so the mechanism a flip depends on is simply absent. Rivals continue to churn players in and out within seconds of each other for fractions of a percent - that is motion, not points, and with a penalty still live and three auctions pending it would be an actively bad use of squad capacity.
